title: EXCLUSIVE Bhutan | FREE Tiger Nest Hiking Experience
highlights: Discover the charm of Bhutan as you explore Thimphu’s vibrant culture and Paro’s iconic landscapes, creating unforgettable memories.
Stand beneath the 177-ft Buddha Dordenma in Thimphu, a symbol of peace, offering panoramic views of the Thimphu Valley and Bhutan’s serene landscapes.
Visit Motithang Takin Preserve, where Bhutan’s rare national animal, the Takin, roams peacefully in its natural habitat amidst the lush green hills.
Hike to the iconic Tiger’s Nest Monastery, perched on a cliffside where Guru Padmasambhava meditated in the sacred caves in the 8th century.
Visit the Ta Dzong, a 17th-century watchtower that now serves as the national museum, showcasing ancient artifacts that narrate the rich heritage of Bhutan.
overview:
About the tour:
Begin your expedition with our Bhutan Tour Package from Siliguri to the enchanting town of Phuentsholing. Feel the vibrant culture of Thimphu and the tranquility of Paro. The climax of your journey is the awe-inspiring excursion to Taktsang, the Tiger's Nest Monastery perched majestically on a cliffside. Opt for this package to connect with Bhutan on a personal level, where every moment becomes a cherished part of your travel story. Join us on this adventure to feel the vibrant vibe of Bhutan.

know_before_you_go: Ask your local guide to help you purchase a SIM on arrival, as Bhutan supports 2 networks: B-Mobile SIM and TashiCell.
Images are for representation purpose only.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.

Indians must pay the Sustainable Development Fee (SDF) of Rs 1200 per person/per night. Children below 5 years are exempted from SDF, while kids between 6 and 12 years of age, will get 50% concession.
To obtain entry in Bhutan, Indian tourists must carry their passports with a minimum 6 months validity and make the payment of SDF.
Plastic has been banned since 1999 in Bhutan, therefore, it is advised to carry plastic/plastic items.
Keep your arms and legs covered while visiting a Dzong (fortress-monastery).
Ask for permission from the attending authority before taking any photos or videos inside places like monasteries.
In Bhutan, Tuesday is ‘Dry Day’. This means locals don’t drink alcohol on Tuesday. So it would be respectful to avoid alcohol on Tuesdays too.
It’s illegal for tobacco to be sold in Bhutan. Tourists can bring cigarettes into the country, but can only smoke them in designated places.
Bhutan does not have a micro (or nano) SIM card. So check your mobile device for SIM compatibility before visiting Bhutan.
Credit cards are widely accepted in major cities and tourist areas. However, it is recommended to carry some cash.
The official currency in Bhutan is the Bhutanese Ngultrum (BTN). It is advisable to exchange currency at banks or authorised exchange bureaus.

Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

Rescheduling Policy for Private (Standard & Deluxe Package) & Group Bookings: 1) If rescheduling is made 7 days after the booking date till 15 days prior to the date of travel then 30.0% of the total tour cost will be charged as rescheduling fees. | 2) If rescheduling is made 0 days to 15 days before the date of travel then 100.0% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. | 3) If bookings are made 15 days before the date of travel no rescheduling & modifications will be made.
Rescheduling Policy for Private (Super Deluxe) & Hotel Specific Bookings: No modification or rescheduling will be catered. A standard cancellation policy will be applicable for such cases.

Cancellation After Rescheduling: Clients who reschedule their tours or treks but later decide to cancel will be subject to our standard cancellation policy. Any rescheduling fees paid will be non-refundable.
Please note that on Saturdays and Sundays, the Phuentsholing Bhutan permit office remains closed.
Please note, the provided vehicle is for point-to-point services only. Any extra usage beyond the itinerary will incur additional charges, payable in cash on the spot.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Siliguri | Transfer to Phuntsholing | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Upon arrival in Siliguri, get transferred to your hotel in Phuntsholing. After check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can visit Bhutan Gate, known for its stunning architecture, or visit Zangto Pelri, home to eight life-sized statues of Guru Padmasambhava. Also, you can visit Karbandi Monastery, one of Bhutan’s oldest, perched in the hills and offering a glimpse into Bhutan’s spiritual heritage. Afterwards, return to your hotel on your own for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Thimphu | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to the immigration office, and get your travel permit to Bhutan. Then, continue your journey to Thimphu, Bhutan’s vibrant capital, and upon arrival, check-in to your hotel. Afterwards, you can head out and stroll through vibrant Clock Tower Square, admiring the intricate traditional architecture. Also, you can explore Simply Bhutan, showcasing the country’s cultural heritage, or witness Bhutan's diverse flora at the Royal Botanical Garden. Later, return to your hotel.

days.title: Thimphu Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Paro
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and enjoy a sightseeing tour of Thimphu. Begin at the National Memorial Chorten, a stunning stupa honoring Bhutan’s third king. Next, visit the Motithang Takin Preserve to witness Bhutan's national animal, the takin, & stroll through the vibrant Handicrafts Market, where you can shop for unique local crafts. Continue to Tashichho Dzong, offering insight into Bhutanese spirituality. Later, get driven to your hotel in Paro for check-in & overnight stay.

days.title: Hike to Tiger’s Nest Monastery
days.desc: Today, visit the Ta Dzong, a watchtower transformed into Bhutan's National Museum, showcasing a rich collection of artifacts. Next, admire the intricate woodwork of Rinpung Dzong, offering stunning views of the Paro Valley. Then, enjoy a scenic hike to the iconic Taktsang Monastery (Tiger's Nest), perched on a cliff. Ascend through lush pine forests, & upon reaching the temple, explore the meditation caves. Later, descend to Satsama Chencho Tshongkhang, and from there, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Phuntsholing | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, after checking out, get transferred to Phuntsholing, a vibrant gateway to Bhutan. Upon arrival, check in and spend the day at leisure, where you can explore the Chukha Hydropower Dam, one of Bhutan's largest, contributing significantly to the country's green energy production. Next, you can take a peaceful stroll along the Torsa River or visit the Palden Tashi Chholing Shedra, a renowned Buddhist learning center. Later, you can indulge in shopping at the Phuntsholing Market.
